verdict.rationale: Porting a number out is a fair question for a cloud telephony product like Aircall, but nothing in the evidence pack covers port-out, lock-in or exit fees, or showing in the app the account details a gaining carrier needs. The items provided cover the API, webhooks, campaigns, IVR and AI features, none of which relate to porting.

support.subject: As a founder, I can port my number out without lock-in fees, with the account details the gaining carrier needs available in the app
